properties.name: Shasta-Trinity National Forest
properties.description: California's largest national forest: Mount Shasta, the Trinity Alps, Shasta & Trinity Lakes.

properties.name: Inyo National Forest
properties.description: Eastern Sierra crest: Mount Whitney, Mammoth Lakes, June Lake Loop, Big Pine Creek, and the Ancient Bristlecone Pine Forest.

properties.name: Modoc National Forest
properties.description: Northeast California's volcanic plateau, Medicine Lake Highlands, and the South Warner Mountains.

properties.name: Klamath National Forest
properties.description: 1.7 million acres of the Klamath Mountains: Marble Mountain & Russian Wildernesses, Scott and Salmon River canyons.

properties.name: Los Padres National Forest
properties.description: Big Sur's Santa Lucia Range (Ventana & Silver Peak Wildernesses) south through the Transverse Ranges.

properties.name: Lassen National Forest
properties.description: Surrounds Lassen Volcanic NP: Caribou, Thousand Lakes, and Ishi Wildernesses; Hat Creek and Lake Almanor.

properties.name: Plumas National Forest
properties.description: Feather River canyons, Lakes Basin, Bucks Lake, and Feather Falls (410 ft).

properties.name: Sierra National Forest
properties.description: Between Yosemite and Kings Canyon: Huntington Lake, Shaver Lake, Ansel Adams, Kaiser, and Dinkey Lakes Wildernesses.

properties.name: Sequoia National Forest
properties.description: Giant Sequoia NM, Kern River canyon, Golden Trout & Domeland Wildernesses, and Hume Lake.

properties.name: Stanislaus National Forest
properties.description: Emigrant & Carson-Iceberg Wildernesses, Pinecrest Lake, Sonora Pass, and the Tuolumne River gorge.

properties.name: Six Rivers National Forest
properties.description: Smith, Klamath, Trinity, Mad, Van Duzen and Eel River country inland from the redwood coast.

properties.name: Humboldt-Toiyabe National Forest (CA districts)
properties.description: Bridgeport and Carson Ranger Districts on the eastern Sierra: Hoover Wilderness, Twin Lakes, and Sonora/Monitor Passes.

properties.name: Mendocino National Forest
properties.description: The only national forest in California with no paved highway crossing: Snow Mountain, Lake Pillsbury, Yolla Bolly.

properties.name: Tahoe National Forest
properties.description: North Yuba and American River headwaters: Sierra Buttes, Donner Summit, and Granite Chief Wilderness.

properties.name: Eldorado National Forest
properties.description: Crystal Basin, Desolation & Mokelumne Wildernesses, Carson Pass, and the South Fork American River.

properties.name: Lake Tahoe Basin Management Unit
properties.description: USFS lands ringing Lake Tahoe: Desolation Wilderness gateways, Tahoe Rim Trail, and lakeshore campgrounds.

properties.name: Sequoia-Kings Canyon Wilderness
properties.description: 768,000-acre High Sierra core: Evolution Basin, Rae Lakes, Sixty Lake Basin, the Great Western Divide, and the Kern Canyon.

properties.name: Yosemite Wilderness
properties.description: 95% of Yosemite National Park: Grand Canyon of the Tuolumne, Cathedral Range, Clark Range, and 750+ miles of trail (permits required).

properties.name: John Muir Wilderness
properties.description: The crown jewel of the Sierra Nevada: Mount Whitney (14,505 ft), Evolution Basin, Palisades, and high alpine passes.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Trinity Alps Wilderness
properties.description: Second-largest wilderness in California; jagged white granite peaks, glacier-carved alpine tarns, and Canyon Creek.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Golden Trout Wilderness
properties.description: Home waters of California's state fish along the Little Kern and South Fork Kern; Cottonwood Lakes and Kern Plateau meadows.

properties.name: Ventana Wilderness
properties.description: Steep coastal Santa Lucia Mountains, Sykes Hot Springs, Big Sur headwaters, and deep redwood canyons.

properties.name: Ansel Adams Wilderness
properties.description: Dramatic Ritter Range, Minarets, Banner Peak, Thousand Island Lake, and the famed John Muir Trail.

properties.name: White Mountains Wilderness
properties.description: White Mountain Peak (14,252 ft) and the Ancient Bristlecone Pine Forest region.

properties.name: Marble Mountain Wilderness
properties.description: Marble-capped peaks, 89 trout lakes, and the PCT along the Marble Rim in the Klamath Mountains.

properties.name: Inyo Mountains Wilderness
properties.description: Steep desert range rising 10,000 ft above Owens Valley opposite the Sierra crest.

properties.name: Yolla Bolly-Middle Eel Wilderness
properties.description: Northern Coast Range high country: Solomon Peak, Mount Linn, and the Middle Fork Eel headwaters.

properties.name: Siskiyou Wilderness
properties.description: Remote Siskiyou crest with Preston Peak, Clear Creek, and exceptional conifer diversity.

properties.name: Carson-Iceberg Wilderness
properties.description: Volcanic Dardanelles, the Iceberg granite dome, and Carson River headwaters along the PCT between Ebbetts and Sonora Passes.

properties.name: Domeland Wilderness
properties.description: Granite domes above the South Fork Kern River on the southern Sierra Kern Plateau; PCT crosses its eastern edge.

properties.name: Hoover Wilderness
properties.description: Sawtooth Ridge, Twenty Lakes Basin, and Green Creek on the east side of Yosemite.

properties.name: Emigrant Wilderness
properties.description: High Sierra granite basin bordering northern Yosemite; pristine subalpine lakes and glaciated plateaus.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Mokelumne Wilderness
properties.description: High alpine volcanic spires, July wildflower superblooms at Winnemucca Lake, Round Top (10,381 ft), and Carson Pass.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Lassen Volcanic Wilderness
properties.description: Backcountry of Lassen Volcanic NP: Cinder Cone, Snag Lake, the Painted Dunes, and Juniper Lake.

properties.name: South Warner Wilderness
properties.description: Remote northeast California crest: Eagle Peak (9,892 ft) and the Summit Trail.

properties.name: Desolation Wilderness
properties.description: Glaciated alpine granite wonderland: Lake Aloha, Mount Tallac (9,735 ft), Velma Lakes, and the Pacific Crest Trail.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Snow Mountain Wilderness
properties.description: Twin 7,000-ft summits of Snow Mountain, the highest point of the inner Coast Range near Clear Lake.

properties.name: South Sierra Wilderness
properties.description: Southern Sierra crest along the PCT: Olancha Peak, Monache Meadows, and the South Fork Kern River.

properties.name: Yuki Wilderness
properties.description: Rugged Eel River canyon country of the Mendocino National Forest.

properties.name: Monarch Wilderness
properties.description: Rugged, trail-sparse walls of the Kings River canyon between Kings Canyon NP and Hume Lake.

properties.name: King Range Wilderness
properties.description: California's Lost Coast: 25 miles of roadless beach trail beneath 4,000-ft King Peak (tide-dependent).

properties.name: Ishi Wilderness
properties.description: Low-elevation basalt canyons of Mill and Deer Creeks; best in spring wildflower season.

properties.name: John Krebs Wilderness
properties.description: Mineral King valley and its glacial lakes (Monarch, Eagle, White Chief, Franklin) in southern Sequoia National Park.

properties.name: Mount Shasta Wilderness
properties.description: The 14,179-ft stratovolcano and its seven glaciers; Avalanche Gulch, Casaval Ridge, and Clear Creek climbing routes.

properties.name: Silver Peak Wilderness
properties.description: Southern Big Sur's wildest coast range: Salmon Creek Falls, the southernmost coast redwoods, and Cruickshank camp.

properties.name: Mount Rose Wilderness
properties.description: Highest point in the Tahoe Basin rim's northern half: Mount Rose (10,776 ft), Galena Falls, and Relay Peak on the Tahoe Rim Trail.

properties.name: Dinkey Lakes Wilderness
properties.description: Sixteen small granite lakes and the Three Sisters above Courtright Reservoir; gentle loop backpacking.

properties.name: Cache Creek Wilderness
properties.description: Cache Creek canyon and Blue Ridge: wintering bald eagles, tule elk, and whitewater in spring.

properties.name: Granite Chief Wilderness
properties.description: Headwaters of the American River west of Palisades Tahoe, crossed by the PCT and the Tahoe Rim Trail.

properties.name: Phillip Burton Wilderness
properties.description: Point Reyes wilderness: Wildcat Camp, Alamere Falls, Bear Valley, and Inverness Ridge.

properties.name: Bucks Lake Wilderness
properties.description: Spanish Peak and the Feather River canyon rim along the PCT above Bucks Lake.

properties.name: Kaiser Wilderness
properties.description: Kaiser Ridge above Huntington Lake with panoramic views of the Ritter Range and Mount Ritter.

properties.name: Santa Lucia Wilderness
properties.description: Lopez Canyon and Big Falls in the southern Santa Lucia Range near San Luis Obispo.

properties.name: Caribou Wilderness
properties.description: Gentle volcanic plateau dotted with 20+ forested lakes east of Lassen Volcanic NP.

properties.name: Red Buttes Wilderness
properties.description: Serpentine-red peaks straddling the Oregon border along the PCT.

properties.name: Machesna Mountain Wilderness
properties.description: Rugged La Panza Range chaparral and condor flyways east of Santa Margarita.

properties.name: Thousand Lakes Wilderness
properties.description: Glacial basin of Magee Peak and Crater Peak north of Lassen; Lake Eiler and the Thousand Lakes Valley.

properties.name: Hain Wilderness
properties.description: Pinnacles' volcanic High Peaks and Chalone Peak backcountry; California condor habitat.

properties.name: Owens River Headwaters Wilderness
properties.description: Glass Creek Meadow and the San Joaquin Ridge headwaters of the Owens River north of Mammoth Mountain.

properties.name: Garcia Wilderness
properties.description: Chaparral ridges of Garcia Mountain above the upper Salinas River.

properties.name: South Fork Eel River Wilderness
properties.description: Angelo Coast Range Reserve neighbor: old-growth Douglas-fir along the South Fork Eel.

properties.name: Russian Wilderness
properties.description: Compact granite cirque-lake country along the PCT between the Trinity Alps and Marble Mountains.

properties.name: Elkhorn Ridge Wilderness
properties.description: Douglas-fir and oak ridges above the South Fork Eel River.

properties.name: Castle Crags Wilderness
properties.description: Granite spires above Castle Crags State Park; the PCT traverses the base of the crags.

properties.name: Sanhedrin Wilderness
properties.description: Sanhedrin Mountain ridge and Eel River tributaries above Lake Pillsbury.

properties.name: Jennie Lakes Wilderness
properties.description: Compact granite-lake wilderness bordering Sequoia NP; easy overnight to Jennie and Weaver Lakes from Big Meadows.

properties.name: Chanchelulla Wilderness
properties.description: Chanchelulla Peak and old-growth fir forest south of Hayfork.

properties.name: North Fork Wilderness
properties.description: Deep, trail-less canyon of the North Fork Eel River.

properties.name: Sinkyone Wilderness State Park
properties.description: Southern Lost Coast: Usal Beach, Bear Harbor, and the Lost Coast Trail through redwood and prairie headlands.

properties.name: Mount Lassic Wilderness
properties.description: Mount Lassic's twin rocky summits and serpentine barrens in the southern Six Rivers NF.

properties.name: Cedar Roughs Wilderness
properties.description: Rare Sargent cypress stands on serpentine ridges west of Lake Berryessa.

properties.name: Berryessa Snow Mountain National Monument
properties.description: Inner Coast Range wildlands from Lake Berryessa to Snow Mountain: tule elk, bald eagles, Cache Creek, and serpentine wildflowers.

properties.name: Smith River National Recreation Area
properties.description: California's last major undammed river system: emerald-green pools, old-growth redwoods, and wild & scenic river corridors.

properties.name: Giant Sequoia National Monument
properties.description: 33 giant sequoia groves surrounding Sequoia & Kings Canyon NPs, including the Trail of 100 Giants and Hume Lake.

properties.name: Shasta Unit (Whiskeytown-Shasta-Trinity NRA)
properties.description: California's largest reservoir: 365 miles of shoreline, houseboating, Shasta Caverns, and lakeside USFS campgrounds.

properties.name: Trinity Unit (Whiskeytown-Shasta-Trinity NRA)
properties.description: Trinity Lake (Clair Engle Lake) beneath the Trinity Alps: quiet coves, boat-in camps, and trailheads into the Trinity Alps Wilderness.

properties.name: Alabama Hills National Scenic Area
properties.description: World-famous golden granite rock arches and rounded labyrinth boulders directly beneath snow-capped Mount Whitney.

properties.name: Fort Ord National Monument
properties.description: 86 miles of oak-woodland and maritime chaparral trails above Monterey Bay; world-class mountain biking (Sea Otter Classic).

properties.name: Yosemite National Park
properties.description: World-renowned glaciated granite valley, giant sequoias, Half Dome, El Capitan, and high alpine meadows.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Kings Canyon National Park
properties.description: Deepest canyon in North America (8,200 ft): Zumwalt Meadow, Roaring River Falls, Cedar Grove, Grant Grove's General Grant Tree, and the Rae Lakes Loop.

properties.name: Sequoia National Park
properties.description: Giant Forest with the General Sherman Tree (largest tree on Earth by volume), Moro Rock, Crystal Cave, Mineral King, and the High Sierra Trail to Mount Whitney.

properties.name: Lassen Volcanic National Park
properties.description: All four volcano types represented: Lassen Peak, Bumpass Hell hydrothermal boardwalk, Manzanita Lake, and Cinder Cone.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Redwood National Park
properties.description: Tallest trees on Earth along the Del Norte & Humboldt coast: Tall Trees Grove, Lady Bird Johnson Grove, Gold Bluffs Beach, and Roosevelt elk herds.

properties.name: Point Reyes National Seashore
properties.description: Wild Pacific coastal wilderness, tidefall waterfall Alamere Falls, tule elk reserve, and coastal backcountry trail camps.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Lava Beds National Monument
properties.description: Over 700 lava tube caves, cinder cones, and Modoc War history on the Medicine Lake volcano's flank.

properties.name: Whiskeytown National Recreation Area
properties.description: Crystal-clear mountain lake ringed by pine forests and multi-tier waterfalls like Whiskeytown Falls and Brandy Creek Falls.

properties.name: Pinnacles National Park
properties.description: Volcanic spires, talus caves, soaring California Condors, and High Peaks climbing trails.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Marin Headlands (GGNRA)
properties.description: Golden Gate coastal bluffs, Kirby Cove, Hawk Hill raptor migration, and historic military batteries.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Devils Postpile National Monument
properties.description: Geometric 60-foot basalt columns and 101-foot Rainbow Falls on the Middle Fork San Joaquin River; JMT and PCT pass through.

properties.name: Muir Woods National Monument
properties.description: Old-growth coast redwood cathedral in Redwood Canyon below Mount Tamalpais; timed parking reservations required.

properties.name: Henry W. Coe State Park
properties.description: Northern California’s largest state park; rugged Diablo Range backcountry, steep oak ridges, remote trout streams, and dark starry skies.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Humboldt Redwoods State Park
properties.description: World's largest remaining old-growth coast redwood forest: Avenue of the Giants, Rockefeller Forest, and Founders Grove.

properties.name: Mono Lake Tufa State Natural Reserve
properties.description: Otherworldly tufa towers on the shores of the ancient saline Mono Lake; South Tufa boardwalk and Navy Beach.

properties.name: Del Norte Coast Redwoods State Park
properties.description: Redwoods plunging to the sea at Damnation Creek and Mill Creek Campground.

properties.name: San Luis Reservoir State Recreation Area
properties.description: Pacheco Pass reservoir with Basalt and Medeiros campgrounds, windsurfing, and striped bass.

properties.name: Mount Diablo State Park
properties.description: 3,849-foot summit with views across 40 California counties, sandstone rock labyrinths at Rock City, and spring wildflowers.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Big Basin Redwoods State Park
properties.description: California’s oldest state park (1902); resilient ancient redwoods rebounding with vibrant growth; gateway to Berry Creek Falls.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Prairie Creek Redwoods State Park
properties.description: Fern Canyon, Gold Bluffs Beach, Elk Prairie herds, and the James Irvine Trail through towering redwoods.

properties.name: Lake Tahoe-Nevada State Park
properties.description: Sand Harbor crystal-turquoise boulder coves, Spooner Lake cross-country ski trails, and the famed Marlette Flume Trail.

properties.name: Jedediah Smith Redwoods State Park
properties.description: Stout Grove and the emerald Smith River; Howland Hill Road and Boy Scout Tree Trail.

properties.name: Mendocino Headlands State Park
properties.description: Blufftop sea arches and blowholes encircling historic Mendocino village.

properties.name: Calaveras Big Trees State Park
properties.description: Spectacular giant sequoias in North and South Groves, roaring Stanislaus River, and historic Discovery Tree.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Armstrong Redwoods SNR & Austin Creek SRA
properties.description: Colonel Armstrong's 1,400-year-old redwoods and the oak-studded ridges of Austin Creek above Guerneville (Bullfrog Pond camp).

properties.name: Mount Tamalpais State Park
properties.description: Panoramic ocean and bay views, 60+ miles of premier trails (Dipsea, Steep Ravine), redwood groves, and Stinson Beach connection.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Salt Point State Park
properties.description: Dramatic sandstone coastal cliffs with tafoni honeycombed rock formations, pygmy cypress forests, and underwater marine reserve.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Castle Rock State Park
properties.description: Wind-sculpted sandstone outcrops and Castle Rock Falls on the Skyline crest of the Santa Cruz Mountains.

properties.name: Trione-Annadel State Park
properties.description: 40 miles of singletrack and Lake Ilsanjo in the hills above Santa Rosa.

properties.name: Sonoma Coast State Park
properties.description: 17 miles of dramatic rugged shoreline, crashing Pacific breakers, Bodega Dunes, Goat Rock sea stacks, and Russian River mouth.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Plumas-Eureka State Park
properties.description: Historic gold-mining stamp mill, Eureka Peak, and lakes of the Lakes Basin near Graeagle.

properties.name: Butano State Park
properties.description: Quiet, secluded redwood canyon sanctuary near Pescadero; lush ferns, Candelabra trees, and shaded mountain ridges.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Andrew Molera State Park
properties.description: Big Sur River mouth, walk-in trail camp, and the Bluffs/Panorama/Ridge loop.

properties.name: Henry Cowell Redwoods State Park
properties.description: Magnificent old-growth redwood grove with 277-foot ancient trees, San Lorenzo River swimming holes, and observation deck.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Castle Crags State Park
properties.description: 6,000-foot sheer granite spires looming above pine forests with jaw-dropping views of snow-capped Mt. Shasta.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Sugarloaf Ridge State Park
properties.description: Sonoma Valley jewel with 25-foot seasonal waterfall, Robert Ferguson public observatory, and Bald Mountain summit panorama.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Julia Pfeiffer Burns State Park
properties.description: World-famous McWay Falls plunging 80 feet directly onto a pristine white sand beach cove; granite coastal cliffs.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Donner Memorial State Park
properties.description: Historic Sierra pass park along Donner Lake with pine forest camping, Emigrant Trail Museum, and lakeside sandy beach.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Samuel P. Taylor State Park
properties.description: Lush old-growth redwood forests along Lagunitas Creek with paved cross-park bike trail and historic papermill ruins.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Portola Redwoods State Park
properties.description: Deep, quiet, rugged redwood canyon with Peters Creek ancient grove, Slate Creek, and remote tranquility in the Santa Cruz Mountains.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Sugar Pine Point State Park
properties.description: Premier Lake Tahoe year-round state park; pristine forested lakeshore, historic Ehrman Mansion, and winter cross-country skiing.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Bothe-Napa Valley State Park
properties.description: Year-round camping in the heart of Napa wine country; shaded redwoods and bigleaf maples along Ritchey Creek.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Van Damme State Park
properties.description: Lush fern canyon along Little River, pygmy forest boardwalk, and sheltered ocean cove popular for sea kayaking and abalone diving.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: D.L. Bliss State Park
properties.description: Granite cliffs, Rubicon Point lighthouse, turquoise water coves, and the famed Rubicon Trail connecting to Emerald Bay.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Emerald Bay State Park
properties.description: One of the world’s most photographed vistas; vibrant green-blue glacial fjord, Vikingsholm Scandinavian castle, and boat-in camp.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: China Camp State Park
properties.description: Sun-drenched oak and bay laurel woodlands along San Pablo Bay; 15 miles of mountain biking and historic Chinese shrimp fishing village.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Russian Gulch State Park
properties.description: Mendocino coast gem with 36-foot waterfall, historic Frederick W. Panhorst concrete arch bridge, and Devil’s Punchbowl ocean blowhole.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Pfeiffer Big Sur State Park
properties.description: Premier Big Sur valley redwoods along the Big Sur River; Pfeiffer Falls, Valley View, and access to Big Sur coastline.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: McArthur-Burney Falls State Park
properties.description: 129-foot spring-fed Burney Falls gushing 100 million gallons daily into an azure pool; Pacific Crest Trail hub.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Hendy Woods State Park
properties.description: Big Hendy and Little Hendy old-growth redwood groves along the Navarro River in Anderson Valley.

properties.name: Angel Island State Park
properties.description: Jewel of San Francisco Bay; 360-degree views of SF skyline and Golden Gate, historic Immigration Station, and paddle-in kayak camps.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Limekiln State Park
properties.description: Redwood canyon with 1880s lime kilns, a 100-ft waterfall, and beach camping on the Big Sur coast.

properties.name: Clear Lake State Park
properties.description: Lakeside camping on California's largest natural freshwater lake beneath Mount Konocti.

properties.name: Grover Hot Springs State Park
properties.description: Hot springs pools in a Sierra meadow at the foot of Markleeville; trail to Burnside Lake falls.

properties.name: Point Lobos State Natural Reserve
properties.description: "Greatest meeting of land and water in the world": Cypress Grove, China Cove, sea otters, and harbor seals.

properties.name: Sunset State Beach
properties.description: Wide dune-backed beach on southern Monterey Bay with pine-sheltered campsites.

properties.name: Brannan Island State Recreation Area
properties.description: Delta waterway crossroads with warm water swimming, sailing, world-class fishing, and winding sloughs.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Fremont Peak State Park
properties.description: 3,169-foot summit on the Gavilan Range with panoramic views of Monterey Bay, astronomical observatory, and oak grasslands.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: Half Moon Bay State Beach
properties.description: Four miles of broad sandy Pacific beaches, Francis Beach blufftop camping, and paved Coastside Trail.
properties.source: Official agency GIS (NPS LRD / CSP EnterpriseGIS / Wilderness Connect)

properties.name: New Brighton State Beach
properties.description: Blufftop campground above Monterey Bay in Capitola; Monarch butterfly overwintering.

properties.name: Sunol-Ohlone Regional Wilderness
properties.description: Little Yosemite gorge, Mission Peak backside, and the 28-mile Ohlone Wilderness Trail backpacking route (permit required).

properties.name: Anthony Chabot Regional Park
properties.description: Forested eucalyptus and pine ridges above Lake Chabot with extensive hiking, biking, and horse trails.

properties.name: Del Valle Regional Park
properties.description: 5-mile reservoir in oak hills with warm water swimming, boating, and Ohlone Wilderness Trail trailhead.

properties.name: Mount Madonna County Park
properties.description: Coast redwood forest on the mountain ridge between Gilroy and Watsonville; canvas yurts and white deer sanctuary.

properties.name: Sanborn County Park
properties.description: Lush redwood forest above Saratoga with direct trail connection to Castle Rock State Park sandstone spires.

properties.name: Uvas Canyon County Park
properties.description: Lush waterfall canyon featuring six cascading multi-tier natural waterfalls along Swanson Creek.

properties.name: Memorial County Park
properties.description: Historic coast redwood park along Pescadero Creek with natural swimming holes and Mt. Ellen trail.
